snippet.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Smash-Up (2009) - Wii Longplay | Full Game Walkthrough | No Commentary
snippet.description:
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Smash-Up (2009) for Nintendo Wii - complete full game longplay with no commentary. Experience the complete fighting game based on the legendary Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles franchise in this full gameplay walkthrough.

Originally released in 2009 for the Nintendo Wii, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Smash-Up is a fast-paced platform fighting game inspired by the Super Smash Bros. formula. Battle as Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello, Raphael and many other fan-favorite TMNT characters across interactive arenas featuring exciting hazards and special moves.

Developed by Game Arts in collaboration with Team Ninja, TMNT: Smash-Up features a unique combat system, multiplayer battles, unlockable content and appearances from characters based on the 2007 animated film, Mirage Comics and the classic TMNT universe.

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Smash-Up was released exclusively for the Nintendo Wii. This longplay features the Wii version.
